name: mohtat
description: University of Michigan Mohtat NMC532 / graphite 5 Ah pouch cells, beginning of life. 21 cells: room 25 C (01, 04, 07, 10, 13, 16, 19), cold -5 C (02, 05, ...), hot 45 C (03, 06, ...). HPPC and C/20 at ~25 C for every cell; the ageing cycles (VAL) at the cell's own temperature.

HPPC.note: per ~10 % SOC: C/2 step, 30 min rest, 1C discharge and charge pulses of 9 s, rests with EIS; 1 s

C20.note: C/20 charge from the bottom to 4.2 V (no CV), rest; 10 s

VAL.note: the first ageing cycles at the cell's own temperature (drive cycle for 19-21); 10 s

CRATE1C.note: rest at the bottom, continuous 1C charge to 4.2 V, rest; 10 s
